description: This file is a shell script designed to perform preflight checks for Java 21+ environments. It verifies that environment variables and PATH point to Java Development Kits of version 21 or higher before running Maven builds, ensuring that the system meets the required Java version constraints.

methods.name: print_usage
methods.description: Outputs usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: parse_major_version
methods.description: Parses the major version number from the Java version string.

methods.name: check_env_home
methods.description: Validates that a specified environment variable points to a valid, Java 21+ Java home installation.

methods.name: check_path_java
methods.description: Checks that the 'java' command on the PATH is Java 21+.
